concept: ElastiCache: lazy loading (cache-aside) for repeated queries
tests: Choosing a strategy to cache results of repeated relational DB queries with minimal application changes.
expected: Amazon ElastiCache with the lazy loading (cache-aside) pattern: on a miss, read from the DB and put it in the cache. Triggers: "many repeated identical queries", "reduce database load", "minimal application changes".
why_not: Scaling RDS vertically hits limits and cost; S3 isn't a low-latency cache; moving to DynamoDB is a major rewrite.
